subject: Partial JSON payloads observed — BrightCart integration
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightcart.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Partial JSON payloads observed from Redwood — BrightCart integration

Hi Mina,

We're seeing intermittent parsing failures in our BrightCart->Redwood integration. Around 2027-01-19 09:14:22 UTC one of our jobs failed with a JSON parsing error. Attached is a truncated log and the client-side stack.

Symptoms:
- HTTP responses being read as partial payloads (we're seeing HTTP 206 codes on the client)
- downstream parser fails with "unexpected end of input"
- appears to only affect streamed completion endpoints

Sample request-id: brc-9f2c4
Attached: brightcart_samples.log (contains the request/response headers and truncated body)

Can you confirm whether Redwood returned a partial payload, or if this is on our side?

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Platform Engineer, BrightCart
samantha.lee@brightcart.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightcart.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 15:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Partial JSON payloads observed from Redwood — BrightCart integration

Hi Samantha — thanks for the report and the sample.

Connor (cc) will take a look and try to reproduce. Connor — can you confirm whether our edge returned a 206 or if there was a downstream interruption? Please include trace for brc-9f2c4 if you can.

Samantha — if you have the full TCP capture or the exact timestamp of the request we can do a deeper correlation.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Support Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Partial JSON payloads observed from Redwood — BrightCart integration

Quick triage summary:

- I pulled traces for request id brc-9f2c4 across the edge and backend (edge trace INF-2345).
- Our logs show the request was served with a full 200 response; the backend completion stream produced ~2.4k bytes and the final chunk/EOF is present in our logs.
- No 206 returned from our edge; there is a 200 with Transfer-Encoding: chunked and the chunked stream ends normally.
- I attempted a local repro using BrightCart's sample payload and were unable to get a partial payload; every run completed with full JSON.

Likely hypotheses:
1) Client-side streaming consumer closed the socket early (library-level bug where an early read leads to misinterpreting chunk boundaries).
2) An intermediate proxy (customer infra) trimmed the stream — their logs may show a 499/connection reset.

Next steps I recommend:
- Ask BrightCart for their upstream proxy logs / tcpdump around the timestamp.
- Share our edge trace INF-2345 (attached) and the full request/response headers.

Attachments: repro_attempt_trace-INF-2345.txt

Connor
SRE, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightcart.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 11:23:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Partial JSON payloads observed from Redwood — BrightCart integration

Hi Samantha — thanks for sharing the additional tcpdump; that was helpful.

Summary of our findings:
- We correlated your tcpdump with our edge trace (INF-2345) and confirm Redwood sent a complete chunked response ending with the final 0-length chunk.
- We did not observe any 206 status from our side; the client received the full stream according to our network taps.
- The tcpdump shows BrightCart's client closed the connection shortly before the final chunk arrived; that aligns with the parser error you reported.

Actionable guidance:
- Please try updating your streaming consumer to properly handle chunked Transfer-Encoding and wait for the final chunk/EOF before parsing.
- As a short-term mitigation, retry the request on 5xx/partial-read errors (idempotent / resumable if possible).

If you'd like, we can run a coordinated test (we'll keep a packet capture and you can replay from your side) to validate the fix. If you can provide the exact client-version and the library used for streaming we can reproduce in our lab.

For now I'm closing this incident as "not reproduced on Redwood" — but we're happy to reopen if new evidence shows otherwise.

Attachments: brightcart_samples.log, repro_attempt_trace-INF-2345.txt

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Support Engineer | Redwood Inference
